summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the signing of 20-year land access agreements with three communities at its Los Filos Mine in Mexico. The filing describes a mine restart plan for heap leach operations and technical studies for potential expansion, including a CIL processing facility. No financial terms, transaction structure, or board recommendation are provided. This is an operational update regarding land access and project development, not a special situation. Under US equivalents, this is a routine material event disclosure. No risk-arb or deal mechanics apply.
